data_design: Nominal:48 nominal attempts. Recovery:24 shared nominal +24 single-perturbation attempts. Aggregated:24 shared nominal +12 shared single-perturbation attempts +12 student-prefix/teacher-tail attempts. Temporary bootstrap:24 nominal +12 singles, seed20260916,5000 updates/robot. All final models10000 updates/robot,2 seeds. All failures/exclusions retained; successful sample counts can differ and are reported. No failed-slot replacement. Recovery extra12 and aggregation12 compare equal attempted demonstration budgets, not equal unique-frame counts.
heldout_region_screen: Training trajectories excluded if teacher-labeled state has |yaw|>3deg AND (|y|>8mm OR remaining x>0.33m OR remaining x<-3mm). Audit coverage and do not claim unseen combinations if this screen is violated.
selection: Checkpoint only development loss/ready mistakes; no final test retuning. Final test run after all checkpoints fixed.
boundary: No truth-gated grasp or teacher fallback during independent student evaluation; privileged takeover is training-only.

bootstrap.data: first24 nominal, first4 per recovery factor

pretraining_amendment.reason: Before any student training or final test, extend prefixes beyond early nominal approach to sample closed-loop drift; allow the teacher a full recovery budget after each prefix. Fixed intervention times, no truth-triggered intervention. Strengthen scoring to require the full 0.4s (five 0.1s samples); collected teacher windows already satisfy this.

pre_final_actuator_diagnostic.evidence: Raw recovery16 lateral development trial ended 11.18mm short with forward=0.00461894; calibrated teacher minimum=0.005. Tiny cross-axis regression outputs can also drift. No final-test executions seen.

pre_final_actuator_diagnostic.selection_rule: Use calibrated decoder for ALL six final students iff pooled strict success exceeds raw 2/8 and both previously successful recovery16 cases remain successful. Otherwise use raw for ALL students. No threshold tuning after these eight trials. Teachers retain original command mappings.
pre_final_actuator_diagnostic.scope: A shared deployment calibration, not learned recovery or oracle correction. Model-native predictions and actual issued commands are logged separately.
